XFlow.Name: w_submit_claim
XFlow.Description: Insert a claim as Submitted, then write its SUBMIT audit row

EXECUTION_NODE.Description: claim_id is derived from order_code + item_code, so without the NOT EXISTS guard a double click inserts a second row under the SAME id - and approve and upload both key on claim_id, so every duplicate would be approved and uploaded again.

Method.Command:
INSERT INTO claim.claim_request (
  claim_id, employee_id, participant_name, manager_name, period_name,
  order_code, item_code, customer_name, credited_amount, claim_amount,
  reason_code, reason_notes, status, comments,
  submitted_date, reviewed_date, reviewed_by, uploaded_flag
)
SELECT
  Concat('CLM-', Concat(:v_order_code, Concat('-', :v_item_code))),
  :v_employee_id,
  :v_participant,
  Nvl(:v_manager_name, ''),
  :v_period,
  :v_order_code,
  :v_item_code,
  Nvl(:v_customer_name, ''),
  Nvl(:v_credited_amount, 0),
  :v_claim_amount,
  :v_reason_code,
  Nvl(:v_reason_notes, ''),
  'Submitted',
  '',
  CurDate(),
  NULL,
  '',
  'N'
FROM   dual
WHERE  Nvl(:v_employee_id, '') <> ''
  AND  Nvl(:v_order_code, '')  <> ''
  AND  Nvl(:v_item_code, '')   <> ''
  AND  Nvl(:v_period, '')      <> ''
  AND  Nvl(:v_reason_code, '') <> ''
  AND  Nvl(:v_claim_amount, 0)  > 0
  AND  NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1
                    FROM   claim.claim_request e
                    WHERE  e.order_code = :v_order_code
                      AND  e.item_code  = :v_item_code )

INSERT INTO claim.claim_audit (
  audit_id, claim_id, action_name, from_status, to_status,
  action_by, action_date, comments
)
SELECT
  Concat('AUD-', Concat(Concat('CLM-', Concat(:v_order_code, Concat('-', :v_item_code))), Concat('-', FormatDateTime(Now(), 'yyyyMMddHHmmss')))),
  Concat('CLM-', Concat(:v_order_code, Concat('-', :v_item_code))),
  'SUBMIT',
  'Draft',
  'Submitted',
  :v_participant,
  CurDate(),
  Nvl(:v_reason_notes, '')
FROM   claim.claim_request c
WHERE  c.claim_id = Concat('CLM-', Concat(:v_order_code, Concat('-', :v_item_code)))
  AND  c.status   = 'Submitted'
